items.t: Shaughnessy, Vancouver: 36 houses sold at a median of $4,817,500, with the middle half between $3,772,500 and $6,088,500. The median house took 62 days to sell and closed at 91.6% of list.

9 townhomes sold in Shaughnessy, Vancouver at a median of $2,076,500 (middle half $1,925,000 to $2,280,000). A typical townhome in Shaughnessy, Vancouver spent 37 days on the market and closed at 97.9% of the asking price.

How Shaughnessy compares with the rest of Vancouver West

items.t: Houses in Shaughnessy have the highest median of the 17 Vancouver West sub-areas, $4,817,500, ahead of South Granville at $3,640,000; the lowest is University at $1,549,000.

Of 18 Vancouver West sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Shaughnessy ranks second highest at $2,076,500; the range is $850,000 (False Creek) to $2,255,000 (Coal Harbour). Quilchena ($1,870,000) sits just below and Coal Harbour ($2,255,000) sits just above.
